parameters.content:
## 🚀 SETUP — DO THIS FIRST

**1. Discord webhook:** create your own webhook (Discord → Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy URL) and paste it into the "Post to Discord" node URL field.

**2. GitHub PAT (free):** github.com/settings/tokens → generate a token (fine-grained or classic — NO scopes needed, we only read public data). In n8n: Credentials → New → Header Auth → Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer ghp_yourtoken. Select this credential in the two GitHub nodes (Get Recent Star Events, Enrich User Profile).

**3. Groq key (free):** console.groq.com → API Keys → create one. Header Auth credential → Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer gsk_yourkey. Select it in "AI Pitch (Groq LLM)".

**4. Demo run:** click "Execute workflow" — the Manual Trigger pushes the 10 most recent stargazers through the whole pipeline.

**5. Go live:** toggle the workflow Active → polls every 15 min with strict dedupe. The first scheduled run sets the baseline silently.

**Different repo?** Change the repo path in the events URL and the repo constant inside the "Rate-Limit Guard & Dedupe" code node.

## 🎯 Trigger + fetch design

- **Trigger:** polling via Schedule Trigger every 15 min. (GitHub's native star webhook is the zero-latency alternative, but it needs a public URL — polling keeps this demoable locally.)
- **Why not /stargazers?** In July 2026 GitHub restricted the stargazers & watchers listing endpoints to repo admins and collaborators (anti-spam measure, changelog 2026-06-30). Verified live: an authenticated call to /repos/n8n-io/n8n/stargazers returns **403** for non-collaborators — no token type or scope changes that.
- **The fix:** the public events feed still reports every star. GET /repos/n8n-io/n8n/events?per_page=100 — a **WatchEvent** with action "started" is one star, with `actor.login` + `created_at`.
- Just **1 API call per poll**: the latest 100 events currently contain ~12 fresh stars (verified live).
- Manual run = DEMO (latest 10 stars). Active run = PRODUCTION (strict dedupe persisted in workflow static data).

## 🛡️ Rate-limit strategy (full detail in Logic-Log.md)

- Authorization: Bearer PAT → **5,000 req/hour** instead of 60 unauthenticated.
- Only **1 GitHub call per poll** (one events page).
- Reads **x-ratelimit-remaining** / **x-ratelimit-reset** from the response headers and aborts the run while quota is still healthy (below 20).
- HTTP 403/429 → fail fast and respect the **Retry-After** header; the next scheduled run picks up automatically.
- Enrichment: retryOnFail 3× with 2 s backoff + paced batching (5 items per batch, 2 s between batches).
- The dedupe watermark means no star is ever enriched twice.

## 🧮 The exact business rule

followers > 100 **OR** public_repos > 50 → AI pitch + alert (true branch).

Otherwise → **stop the flow** immediately (false branch → No Operation).

## 🤖 The AI piece

Groq (OpenAI-compatible, free tier): POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions with model openai/gpt-oss-120b.

System prompt: analyze Bio + Company (+ Location) and return EXACTLY ONE sentence (max 25 words) on why Yellow.ai's sales team should reach out.

Swap providers freely: any OpenAI-compatible base URL + model id works here; or replace this HTTP node with n8n's native Basic LLM Chain + Chat Model nodes.

## 📤 Output

"Post to Discord" sends a rich embed per high-value lead: name, login, bio, company, the AI pitch, followers, public repos and the star time.

"Send to Slack (alternative)" is disabled by default: enable it, paste your Slack webhook URL and disconnect the Discord node if your team lives in Slack.
